Install omawake on Omarchy

Configurable local wake-word daemon (pre-built binary)

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omawake-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.1.1-1:
    pacman -Qi omawake-bin

Open and use omawake

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql omawake-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omawake on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omawake-bin. The download is 6.3 MB and it takes 29.1 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omawake free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause.

How do I uninstall omawake?

Run omarchy pkg drop omawake-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does omawake depend on?

The package declares 3 dependencies: alsa-lib, gcc-libs, glibc. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omawake in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omawake-bin (version 0.1.1-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. jacob-vincent-mink makes it. Project site: https://github.com/jacob-vincent-mink/omawake. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
